svg.title: How it works
svg.desc: Your FPGA project files (Vivado, HDL, constraints, PYNQ notebooks, drivers, build logs) go to your AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot or any MCP or skills agent) with the fpa skill. You get a clickable diagram, real bugs with file and line, why the build failed with the fix, and design docs. Runs offline; Vivado is optional.
